name: mcp-headless-app
title: Headless MCP App
description: A complete headless MCP app: static OAuth screens, an MCP Edge Function, and PostgREST database tools.
docs: Required setup: this starter block installs `supabase/config.toml` with OAuth, access-token-hook, and Edge Function settings. Fill in its `project_id`, `site_url`, and `additional_redirect_urls` for your static app host, then set `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in `config.js`. For production OAuth, configure an ES256 or RS256 JWT signing key separately: this is a project-level rotation, not a config.toml setting. An agent may create a standby key through the Management API, but must get approval before rotating it to in_use. The `--yes --overwrite` install command intentionally replaces both this starter config and `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/index.ts`; merge those files manually if your project already has either one. Deploy with `supabase db push`, `supabase config push`, and `supabase functions deploy mcp-server`. The complete manifest already registers the PostgREST toolset; no manual source edit is needed. See the block documentation for the local quickstart and RLS/grant requirements.
